concerns.text: FR-004 requires computing per‑patient slopes of UPDRS Part III scores and correlating them with taxon slopes. However, the project's verified data inventory (see research.md) contains no longitudinal UPDRS III measurements for any PPMI participant, making the primary outcome undefined and the core research question unanswerable with the available data.

FR-007 mandates a permutation test that shuffles patient identifiers while preserving within‑patient time structure. Without any patient‑level UPDRS III time series, the required shuffling scheme cannot be constructed, rendering the requirement infeasible.
